issues.title: Ingest Baxter County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $40,229,425 across 40 funds. The largest: County General ($14,878,639), Road and Bridge ($5,515,140), County General Investments #2 ($5,000,000). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
